question: According to Chapter 2, what is the core unifying theorem regarding the maximum photon retrieval efficiency in Lambda-type atomic media?
ground_truth: The retrieval efficiency of any given stored spin wave depends only on the optical depth d of the medium, because the branching ratio between collectively enhanced emission into desired modes and spontaneous decay depends only on d. Furthermore, optimal storage is the time reverse of retrieval.
expected_facts: Depends only on the optical depth d
Branching ratio between collectively enhanced emission and spontaneous decay
Optimal storage is the time reverse of retrieval

In the Kondo Lattice Model, localized excited e atoms with spin N couple via exchange interaction Vex to mobile ground g atoms, allowing simulation of heavy fermion physics and RKKY interactions.

question: Why are Gaussian inhomogeneous broadening losses non-Markovian, and how does this affect the storage error at high optical depth compared to Lorentzian broadening?
